$comment: PROVIDER-SCOPED handle: it resolves only with the caller's Google credentials and is
namespaced to their project. Emitting it as a plain image_url would hand OpenAI a URL it
cannot fetch, with warnings.length === 0 — i.e. asserted lossless while broken. The IR
models it as { kind: "file", dialect: "gemini" } so every foreign decoder drops it loudly.
